scripts.lint:shell: sh -c 'set -- $(find docker scripts -type f \( -name "*.sh" -o -name "wait-for-x" -o -name "start-chrome" -o -name "gen-squid-conf" \) 2>/dev/null); [ $# -eq 0 ] && { echo "lint:shell: no shell scripts"; exit 0; }; docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/mnt" koalaman/shellcheck:v0.11.0 "$@"'
scripts.lint:docker: sh -c 'rc=0; for f in $(find . -name Dockerfile -not -path "./node_modules/*" -not -path "./spike/*" | sort); do docker run --rm -i hadolint/hadolint:v2.14.0 hadolint - < "$f" || rc=1; done; exit $rc'
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run ui:typecheck && npm run ui:test && npm run lint:shell && npm run lint:docker
